name: PHENIX
full_name: Pioneering High Energy Nuclear Interaction eXperiment
summary: PHENIX operated at RHIC, Brookhaven National Laboratory, Upton, New York. This record summarizes only the historical heavy-ion / nuclear-physics experiment's dark-photon search.
detection_principle: Narrow e⁺e⁻ mass peaks in radiative π⁰ and η decays from high-energy pp and dAu collisions test new vector particles kinetically mixed with the photon.

results.summary: No dark-photon peak; upper limits on mixing squared reach approximately 2×10⁻⁶ and vary with mass.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
